founders.name: Marcelo Araújo
founders.bio: Marcelo founded King Internationals with a vision to bring quality, affordable retail to Portuguese communities. Under his leadership, the group has grown to 9 locations across 6 cities and is now expanding internationally.

founders.name: Romy King
founders.bio: Romy brings international business expertise and a deep commitment to people-first operations. She oversees brand development, international recruitment, and the consumer brands portfolio.
